# Ocean tides

## Why tides happen

Tides are caused by the gravitational pull of the Moon and, to a lesser extent,
the Sun on the Earth's oceans. The side of the Earth facing the Moon and the
side facing away both bulge outward, producing two high tides each day.

## Spring and neap tides

When the Sun, Moon and Earth line up at new moon and full moon, their pulls add
together and produce spring tides with the largest tidal range. At the quarter
moons the pulls partly cancel, giving neap tides with a small range.
